title: TimelineJS unique_id stability and repeat-per-strand experiment brief
purpose: A minimal falsifiable test package for the two main untested inferences from art_01M6K4N37MCKDM0TZB5V9ZGS30 revision 3: (1) that setting unique_id from a canon id keeps hash-bookmark links stable across regenerations, and (2) that the repeat-per-strand convention — one slide per strand for a shared event — is unambiguous to a reader of the generated JSON. Neither claim has been run; this package makes them runnable.
